preflight_scope: Registered exact project feature paths only; clean tracked/untracked state, main ancestry, no active-plan/process/open-file reference or nested registered worktree. All source HEADs are rechecked before each action; no unaccounted ignored file may remain before Git removal.
preservation_scope: Wholly untracked outputs/pytest/tmp directories and fully untracked __pycache__ directories only; tracked contents inside preservation roots and unknown ignored layouts are rejected. Same-volume rename preserves exact directory inodes. No force removal or content rewrite; all source commits remain in main history.
recovery: Recreate the absent original_worktree at source_commit, then restore every preserved directory from the archive at its original relative path without overwriting. For a historical source-bound replay, choose that check own recorded source rather than a later feature HEAD. Historical paths/receipts are not rewritten as if created in the archive.
scope: Operational data-preserving space recovery during unchanged original inference. Logical source sizes and observed free-space changes are not equal or solely attributed to cleanup, since OS swap and other shared filesystem use also vary. No heavy compression, new inference or independent heavy integration QA is run.
